en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing a traditional half‑timbered watermill complex. The main left image depicts a large timber‑framed mill building with a steep tiled roof set in a wooded landscape above a mill race or stream. The two images on the right show interior machinery of the mill on multiple levels and a close view of the façade with timber framing, small windows, a wooden entrance door with stone surround and a wheelbarrow with a sack in front. At the bottom, a white band bears the caption "Schulze‑Mühle‑Gauernitz."
